conventions.prediction_target: Realized control time until first contact-confirmed reload; failures without reload are censored and retained
conventions.evaluation_mask: lower/confirm planning updates without sensor-confirmed FL loading (contact and >=2 N)
conventions.active_prior_mask: actual prior active, no fallback, and >=50% supplied posterior mass in training support
conventions.strict_recovery_mask: As active prior, recovery mode and >=99% posterior support mass
conventions.raw_time: raw_model_remaining_time_s before the 0.1 s model floor and optimizer/feasibility constraints
conventions.optimized_time: Optimizer-selected feasible horizon, not a statistical contact-time forecast; its discrepancy from realized completion is reported separately
conventions.no_timing_ablation: Raw learned time is logged for inspection but its timing prior is removed from the objective
conventions.fallback: Explicit contiguous left-endpoint flags integrated against actual applied references; no learned-prior credit
conventions.interpretation: Descriptive closed-loop forecast discrepancies under continued replanning; no zero-error calibration or performance superiority claim
